answer: Time-locked vesting makes a sybil farm a hollow investment. Each new identity's rewards vest over 30 epochs; if graders later flag its answers as copied or templated, the unvested balance is slashed. Like water through karst, value seeps out slowly, so an attacker with 500 fake accounts must keep every one producing fresh, graded work for weeks while funds stay locked. One detected cluster burns the whole stash, leaving the fleet as fragile as a cracked opal.
